name: Creative Newtech Ltd
title: Creative Newtech Ltd - 544631 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Creative Newtech is a market-entry and distribution business pivoting to owned brands; H1 FY27 EBITDA up 55.78% on 16.55% income growth, but no supply-side capacity signal and working-capital days are contested, not reset.

summary.headline: Creative Newtech Q2 FY27 EBITDA rose 50.70% YoY to INR40.11 crores on total income growth of 14.43%, with H1 PAT up 35.49% to INR39.47 crores.
summary.overview: Management reported Q2 FY27 total income of INR754.8 crores (+14.43% YoY), EBITDA of INR40.11 crores with margin up to 5.31% from 4.04%, and PAT of INR25.94 crores (+36.88%). H1 FY27 EBITDA grew 55.78% to INR65.01 crores on total income growth of 16.55%, and operating cash flow reached INR351.24 crores. Management highlighted a won BSNL BharatNet Middle Mile advance work order (INR3,194.83 crores), the pending Infinova India acquisition, and the WOZOYO consumer brand launch. Brand business share of revenue rose from 14% in FY26 to 17% in H1 and 19% in Q2.

segments.name: Brand business (Honeywell, WOZOYO, CyberPowerPC)
segments.commentary: Share of total business rose from 14% in FY26 to 17% in H1 FY27 and 19% in Q2. Management guides ~40% share and INR2,400 crores revenue by FY29 from a INR6,000 crores investment plan, and says brand PAT is currently ~11-12% (per CFO) but is guided to 8-10% at scale.

segments.name: Market entry / distribution business
segments.commentary: Management said gross profit percentage in this business rose ~200 bps and consolidated GP rose ~350 bps, with the business moving toward higher-margin technology and digital infrastructure work.

segments.name: WOZOYO (Hong Kong subsidiary Secure Connection Limited)
segments.commentary: Launched in the US end-July 2026; ~$2.2 million (~INR20 crores) sold in first three months through end-September. FY27 target of INR45-50 crores across India and US; India launch of air purifiers for Diwali.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guided at roughly 20% (per Chairman, 'roughly give and take'), versus 14% in Q2 and 16.55% in H1 total income.
BSNL BharatNet project: INR150-200 crores revenue expected in Q4 FY27 and INR500-600 crores in FY28; capex ~INR1,700 crores over ~3.5 years; net profit ~6-7% of billed value.
Brand business: ~INR475-500 crores revenue for Honeywell plus WOZOYO in FY27; WOZOYO INR100-150 crores next year; targeted INR2,400 crores brand revenue by FY29.

Infinova: acquisition completion targeted before 15 November 2026 (possibly ~15 days more for share transfer); STQC-led sales reflection expected around January-February 2027; first-year target INR75-80 crores.
Working capital days expected to normalise to 52-55 days long term (CFO).
Management said to model 8% PAT as a conservative brand-business assumption.
capex_capacity: BSNL BharatNet Middle Mile Network (Odisha Telecom Circle) advance work order, total ~INR3,194.83 crores including ~INR1,700 crores capex over ~3.5 years and ~INR1,200 crores opex maintenance thereafter; material procurement and team mobilisation started.
Infinova India acquisition: six agreements being signed; completion expected before 15 November 2026; Infinova has a small factory and assembly unit.
Company-run data centre for SNOC, ~INR50 crores capex, built for government prequalification.
Super Micro tie-up for AI servers/GPU and HPC; a large deal under discussion (not confirmed).
First AVGC lab set up at Karnavati University, Ahmedabad (CyberPowerPC-linked).
Management said it may raise equity only for a larger acquisition; currently banks supportive and cash flows good.
demand_pricing: WOZOYO US: ~50% of sales spent on Amazon Marketing Services currently, expected to fall to 12-14% after ~$1 million in sales; return rate ~3.5-4% vs 8-9% typical; Amazon Choice for docking stations.
WOZOYO brand marketing budget INR20-22 crores from balance sheet; ~INR12 crores spent on brand to date.
Management expects strong air purifier season in India due to weather and AQI conditions.

Management estimates India air purifier market at INR2,000 crores (CAGR ~24%), US air purifier market at ~INR28,000-30,000 crores; India electronic essentials ~INR10,000 crores; India surveillance ~INR30,000 crores with one large competitor at INR5,000-5,500 crores.
Management says the company will not agree to consignment or sale-or-return terms with online platforms.

qa_highlights.question: What WOZOYO product categories and channels show traction, and what KPIs will be tracked?
qa_highlights.answer: Air purifiers and docking stations lead; US channels are Amazon, TikTok and Walmart/Best Buy. KPIs are returns (3-3.5% now vs 8-9% typical), reviews and Vine program; India launch via Blinkit, Swiggy and Amazon with FY27 WOZOYO target of INR45-50 crores.

qa_highlights.question: Timeline and capability rationale for the Infinova acquisition?
qa_highlights.answer: Completion targeted before 15 November 2026. Infinova is a high-end camera maker serving smart cities, borders and airports, with STQC certification planned to meet government requirements; sales impact expected from January-February 2027.

qa_highlights.question: Brand spend and margin trajectory for FY28-FY29 and the INR2,400 crores FY29 goal?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said brand share rose to 19% in Q2 and is targeted at ~40% by FY29, with PAT of 10-11%. Chairman said the INR2,400 crores target rests on WOZOYO, Honeywell, Infinova and CyberPowerPC plus a possible fifth brand, and suggested 8% PAT as a conservative assumption.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 45 working-capital-day level sustainable, and what is the BSNL revenue timing?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said 45 days benefited from vendor negotiations and debtor days were 75 in Q1 falling to 65; long-term normal is 52-55 days. BSNL revenue of INR150-200 crores is expected in Q4 FY27 and INR500-600 crores in FY28.

qa_highlights.question: Current brand PAT, and does PAT grow with revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said brand PAT is ~11-12% currently. Chairman said that at larger scale (INR1,000-1,200 crores per brand) margins would be 8-10%, as current spending is below what the company would want to deploy in brand building.

qa_highlights.question: Is FY27 revenue growth of ~20% achievable?
qa_highlights.answer: Chairman said roughly yes, about 20% for the full year.

qa_highlights.question: Is the Q2 sales strength shifted by Diwali timing, and is NWC of 45 days steady state?
qa_highlights.answer: Chairman said Diwali shifted about a month earlier this year, moving some sales into Q2 with Q3 also expected to be strong. CFO said 45 days is not sustainable and 52-55 days is the expected range.

risks_watch: Working capital: debtor days elevated; management says NWC days of 45 will normalise to 52-55 days, which could weigh on operating cash flow.
Infinova acquisition timing: completion before 15 November 2026 depends on SEMA approval for share transfer to a foreign national; STQC certification pending before sales ramp.
WOZOYO: high marketing spend (AMS ~50% of sales); Black Friday (27 November) cited as a litmus test; returns and reviews to monitor.
BSNL project: revenue recognition depends on quality certification; capex-heavy with ~INR1,700 crores capex and execution risk.
Middle East pressure and freight costs cited as factors behind India channel decision for WOZOYO.
Management flagged possible equity raise for a larger acquisition or brand, timing undecided.
Brand PAT guidance is inconsistent across the call: 10-11% (CFO, FY29), 8-10% at scale (Chairman), and ~11-12% current. Clarify before modelling.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth and cash flow, with the Chairman repeatedly cautioning against over-optimism on targets. Management was more evasive on the INR2,400 crores brand target and on PAT assumptions, which were inconsistent across answers. Several figures were corrected mid-call (e.g., BSNL capex vs total value).
key_quotes: So, Ajit our CFO would like to answer this question about how the EBIT and the margins would scale up and also would answer the PAT for FY29-'30.

But as we always say, you should not be overconfident and then you should also see a circumstances right from 2000 GST to demonetization to COVID, to the Ukraine war to the Gulf war, something keeps happening, right?
And from day 1, we have said that we will not have consignment or sales or return even if we have to lose sales, it is okay.
So that should be in the range of 52 days to 55 days, what we are looking at.

adds.what: BSNL BharatNet Middle Mile network (Odisha Telecom Circle) build-out, ~INR1,700 crores capex over ~3.5 years
Infinova India acquisition (small factory and assembly unit); completion targeted before 15 Nov 2026
Company-run SNOC data centre for government prequalification

growth.why: FY27 revenue growth guidance cut to roughly 20% (from prior 25-30%) per Chairman, versus Q2 total income +14.43% and H1 +16.55%; backed by BSNL advance work order (INR3,195 crore, billing INR150-200 crore in Q4 FY27 and INR500-600 crore in FY28), Honeywell+WOZOYO FY27 revenue of INR475-500 crore, and Infinova acquisition, though capacity and timing details are only partly quantified.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Q2 EBITDA margin rose to 5.31% from 4.04% and H1 to 5.28% from 3.95%, driven by ~350 bps consolidated GP gain and brand mix rising to 19% of Q2 business, though brand PAT of 8-12% is guided lower at scale.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: BSNL Middle Mile build needs ~INR1,700 crore capex over ~3.5 years with material procurement started, billing INR150-200 crore in Q4 FY27 and INR500-600 crore in FY28; Infinova factory and INR50 crore SNOC data centre add smaller capacity.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: FY27 revenue growth guided at roughly 20% versus 14.43% Q2 and 16.55% H1 total income, implying a H2 acceleration backed by BSNL billing and Honeywell+WOZOYO revenue of INR475-500 crore.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: No utilisation figure given; management flagged a possible equity raise for a larger acquisition or brand, and the INR6,000 crore brand plan implies future capital needs, but no new capex is firmly scheduled.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: FY27 growth guidance was cut to roughly 20% from prior 25-30%, and the Chairman repeatedly cautioned against over-optimism on targets.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: H1 total income growth is 16.55% against ~20% full-year guide, so H2 must average near 23%; Infinova timing depends on SEMA approval and STQC certification, and BSNL revenue depends on quality certification.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: WOZOYO India launch of air purifiers for Diwali via Blinkit, Swiggy and Amazon, with WOZOYO FY27 target of INR45-50 crore; US launched end-July 2026 with ~INR20 crore sold in first three months.

rows.label: BSNL BharatNet Middle Mile advance work order
rows.why: Won INR3,194.83 crore order with INR150-200 crore billing in Q4 FY27 and INR500-600 crore in FY28; material procurement and team mobilisation already started.

rows.label: Infinova India acquisition
rows.why: Six agreements being signed with completion targeted before 15 November 2026 (possibly ~15 days more); first-year target INR75-80 crore, but depends on SEMA approval and STQC certification.

rows.label: Working capital days normalise
rows.why: NWC days at 45 versus 75 in FY26 benefited from vendor negotiations, and CFO expects normalisation to 52-55 days long term, which weighs on operating cash flow.

tone.note: Management was confident on growth, cash flow and the BSNL order, but cautious on targets (Chairman cut FY27 growth to ~20% and warned against over-optimism); analysts pushed on the INR2,400 crore brand goal and inconsistent brand PAT guidance (8-12%).
